sloka: राग युक्तो मधुकरः कुसुमेषु  आवलीयते।निलीय पुनर् उत्पत्य सहसा अन्यत्र गच्छति ।मधु लुब्धो मधुकरः पंपा तीर द्रुमेषु असौ ॥४-१-८८॥
transliteration: rāga yukto madhukaraḥ kusumeṣu  āvalīyate।nilīya punar utpatya sahasā anyatra gacchati ।madhu lubdho madhukaraḥ paṁpā tīra drumeṣu asau ॥4-1-88॥

translations.english: 'The bees greedy for honey move among the trees on the banks of Pampa. Resting for a while, at one place they fly soon to another.
